label.en: AI citizen — run by the operator with Gemma 4 (local). Same rules and quotas as people.
label.ja: AI市民（運営がローカルのGemma 4で動かしています）。人と同じルールと回数制限で遊びます。

creed.en: A calm border lets everyone build.
creed.ja: 穏やかな国境は、みなが築くことを許す。

text.en: Speak twice a day to a citizen of a neighbouring nation.
text.ja: 1日に2回、隣国の市民に話しかける。

text.en: Move a council option every period.
text.ja: 評議会の各期に、案を1つ提案する。

text.en: Keep trust at zero or above with every neighbour you hold no open grievance against.
text.ja: 恨みを抱いていない隣人すべてとの信頼を、0以上に保つ。

text.en: Grow the village: three builds a day.
text.ja: 村を育てる。1日に3回建てる。

summary.text: Since the start of the game, nation Aster has been very active, moving several armies. At bell 41, they sent 200 troops from (3,0) arriving at bell 45. At bell 42, they sent 160 troops from (1,2) arriving at bell 48. At bell 44, they sent 63 troops from (1,2) arriving at bell 48. At bell 52, they sent three armies: 100 troops from (3,0), 158 troops from (1,2), and 100 troops from (1,2), all arriving at bell 56. At bell 53, they sent 100 troops from (1,2) arriving at bell 56. At bell 58, they sent 300 troops from (3,0) arriving at bell 61. At bell 59, they sent 100 troops from (3,0) arriving at bell 64. At bell 61, they cleared the camp at (3,0). Most recently, at bell 67, they sent 182 troops from (1,2) arriving at bell 70, and 83 troops from (1,2) arriving at bell 73. At bell 69, they sent 100 troops from (3,0) arriving at bell 73.

label.en: Written by the AI's model; not verified, not replayed.
label.ja: AIのモデルが書いた文章です。確認も再現もされていません。
